description: Cursor-style coding agent powered by the full ChomirCode panda engine (HTTP sidecar) in the Chat side bar.
workspaceTrust.description: ChomirCode Agent can read and modify files and run shell commands in this workspace.
chatParticipant.description: Write and edit code with the full ChomirCode panda engine (tools, MCP, permissions, slash, sessions).
config.apiKey: DeepSeek API Key. Use **Configure API Key / Manage Models…** in the Models picker.
config.baseUrl: DeepSeek API base URL. Official default is `https://api.deepseek.com`.
config.enginePath: Absolute path to ChomirCode repo root (directory containing `bin/chomircode-agent.js` and `server/index.js`).
config.permissionMode: How ChomirCode approves tools. Use **Auto-run (bypassPermissions)** to run everything without prompts.
config.permissionMode.bypassPermissions: Auto-run: approve all tools without asking (YOLO).
config.permissionMode.auto: Auto-approve safe actions via classifier; ask when unsure.
config.permissionMode.acceptEdits: Auto-approve workspace file edits; ask for shell / risky tools.
config.permissionMode.default: Ask before almost every tool action.
config.permissionMode.dontAsk: Minimize prompts; deny risky actions when unsure.
config.permissionMode.plan: Plan-only: read tools allowed, no mutating tools.
config.maxRounds: Maximum agent tool-loop rounds per request (CLI fallback).
config.openChangedFiles: After a successful run, open files listed in `changed`.
config.useSidecar: Use the full ChomirCode HTTP sidecar (permissions, steer, MCP, sessions, slash). If false, falls back to one-shot CLI.
config.continueLastSession: When Chat UI history is empty (e.g. after restart), continue the last panda session from `.panda` so agent memory is not lost. Use **ChomirCode: New Session** for a blank agent.
config.contextWindow: Model context window in tokens (Cursor-style). Auto-compact triggers near `contextWindow − compactOutputReserve − autocompactBuffer`. Default 128000.
config.compactOutputReserve: Tokens reserved for model output when computing the auto-compact threshold (default 8192).
config.autocompactBuffer: Extra headroom before the context limit for auto-compact (default 16000). Matches panda/Cursor formula.
